svg.title: Curl and divergence of the unit field of a foliation
svg.desc: Schematic, three planar foliations drawn exactly: parallel lines (curl and divergence zero), a pencil of lines (geodesic leaves whose spacing grows, divergence 1/ℓ) and concentric circles (equally spaced leaves that bend, curl 1/ℓ); ℓ is the distance from the centre.
svg.text: arrows: unit field X · ρ: spacing of neighbouring leaves · ℓ: distance from the centre
arrows: unit field X · ρ: spacing of neighbouring leaves · ℓ: distance from the centre
